verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a marketing-page claim that Loops lets you see which emails lead to upgrades, lower churn, and add revenue. That suggests some conversion attribution per email, but none of the other reporting dimensions are documented. Missing for 10: documented open/click/unsubscribe metrics, per-campaign reporting, per-workflow-step (automation node) metrics, time-series/over-time views, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
